name: zuraedu-ts
description: Esqueleto TypeScript de ZuraEdu (NestJS + Next.js) para la migración gradual (strangler) desde Laravel.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @zuraedu/api && npm run build -w @zuraedu/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @zuraedu/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @zuraedu/api && npm run typecheck -w @zuraedu/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @zuraedu/api && npm run test -w @zuraedu/web
